events.description: Went down under minimal contact, leading to Allan Nyom's controversial red card for Getafe; widely called out as a dive in the press.
Went down theatrically at Anfield in the Champions League; the dive was widely mocked and flooded social media with memes.
Won a second penalty against Sevilla with a theatrical dive; VAR declined to overturn it because there was contact after he had already gone down.
Won a contested penalty in the World Cup quarterfinal against Morocco; replays appeared to show he had gone down before contact from Mazraoui, and Moroccan players argued he had dived.
Named winner of the 2026 Barça Players' Association Award (Premi Barça Jugadors), recognizing the first-team player who showed the most fair play throughout the 2025–26 season.
